title: Training example (single frame)
description: One NDJSON training row emitted by scripts/build_training_dataset.py. Each row is one frame pairing player state (origin/velocity/angles) with the action (movement command) recorded at that command index. This is the RAW shard row; the move model trains on a 6-dim vector derived from it by scripts/move_world_view.py (see configs/extraction_spec.yaml -> derived_model_view).

map.description: Map level name (meta['map_level']); null when serverdata carried no map level.

frame.description: Zero-based COMMAND INDEX (one row per usercmd), NOT a wall-clock/replay time frame. See configs/extraction_spec.yaml per_frame_row.

o.description: Player origin [x, y, z] in world units (floats).

a.description: View angles [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees (floats).

onground.description: Whether the player was on the ground for this frame.

pm_code.description: Player-move type code; -1 when interpolated states disagree.
